review_notes: Twenty-six existing recovered definitions have structured control flow with no remaining jumps or decompiler labels. Focused review preserves callback ordering, repeated engine queries, native event gates, cached snapshots and gameplay quirks. No new native-function coverage or gameplay-equivalence claim.

Split/fuse handlers share event setup while preserving separate half selection, fresh half flags after callbacks, target-slot offsets, priority snapshots and empty-graveyard behavior. Toil/Trouble retains its fallback priority when arbitrary-target validation fails.

Aura routes preserve attachment checks, distinct regeneration queries, cast callbacks and upkeep behavior. Kels and Atla retain source-presence gates, GFP/activation separation, optional payment loops and legacy-effect cleanup. Atla legacy removal remains inside the per-Egg resolution loop.

Gemstone Array preserves repeated paying_mana queries and direct production; Sigil preserves repeated equipment and instance queries. Set-PT legacy retains captured duration flags and source-leaves versus upkeep cleanup. Mimeoplasm preserves face-down selection handling and state cleanup.

Star of Extinction retains separate creature and planeswalker damage tests, current-turn refreshes across callbacks, and damage even when the land target fails validation. Sacrifice and Bomb Squad scans retain cached next indices and live card-count bounds.
One combined incremental build. Full historical audits, inventory regeneration, reccmp refreshes and gameplay tests deferred.
verification_policy: Affected-file hashes and exact token checks for alpha-only edits; focused review for structured edits. Build separately after the combined batch. Inventories and reccmp deferred to a larger checkpoint.
scope: Readability cleanup of existing recovered definitions; no new native coverage or gameplay-equivalence claim.
